approvalEvidence.instructionVerbatim:
I explicitly approve the governed Build 26 campaign using application and backend source baseline commit `7156d456d1f74d21b981231869802304e745755e`.
I approve deploying the existing 15-function fleet to production project `crm3-baf-ops-b8638`, region `asia-south1`, using existing dedicated service accounts, `PreserveExistingIam`, and App Check enforcement remaining false.
I approve deploying Firestore Rules SHA-256 `823877B9B03F8D4E2687532615F5037A9742F3AA224AE209BC2C7A866F845E04` and verifying the unchanged 66-index set SHA-256 `E58BEAEF69212C4B00035C120F345D25F962588EE84ACC6D88363CD5EE2D95A4`, followed by strict live readback.
After successful readback, I approve creating, pushing, reviewing, and merging the necessary backend-reconciliation and Build 26 governance changes, provided all review and CI checks are clean. I approve allocating and constructing production-signed Build 26 (`1.0.0-rc.16+26`) from the exact resulting `main` commit, followed by independent package verification and dual custody.
No IAM change, App Check activation, production business-data mutation or deletion, device-data clearing, installation, distribution, Play Store publication, or unrestricted publication is authorized by this statement.
approvalEvidence.instructionSummary: Deploy and strictly read back the exact Build 26 backend under IAM preservation, then prepare and construct one governed production-signed Build 26 after clean PR review and CI.
approvalEvidence.scopeInterpretation: The instruction authorizes the exact backend campaign, governance reconciliation, one protected Build 26 construction, independent package verification and dual custody. It does not authorize IAM mutation, App Check activation, business-data mutation or deletion, device-data clearing, installation, distribution or publication.

authorityBasis: The owner's explicit Build 26 instruction is bound to exact PR 352 source and its successful post-merge release gate. The existing required-reviewer protection is retained and this record does not itself release signing secrets; production signing still requires the protected run approval event.

singleOperatorConstraint.interpretation: The required-reviewer rule creates a deliberate approval event and prevents unattended secret release; it is not represented as independent two-person approval.

failClosedConditions: Valid only for Build 26 and dispatch reference BAF-REF-003-C25.
The source freeze 7156d456d1f74d21b981231869802304e745755e must be an ancestor of the exact admitted dispatch commit, with artifact-affecting paths unchanged.
The actor and triggering actor must match the authorized dispatcher; the required reviewer must explicitly approve the protected run.
The public repository, main-only environment and disabled administrator bypass must remain unchanged.
No installation, pilot handout, unrestricted distribution, device-data clearing or business-record mutation is authorized by this construction approval.
expiresWhen: Build 26 has a verified remote built tag or the governed repository/environment state differs, whichever occurs first.
